answer: Every claim passes a quartz hourglass: the agent must complete a sonnet of fourteen sequential checks, each a stranger's micro-audit whose output seeds the next step, so the chain cannot be split across clones or run in parallel. A mirror bounty pays any stranger who posts a copy of the claim's evidence reused under another identity; the reused bond is slashed and split with the hunter. With n clones there are n(n-1)/2 matchable pairs, so detection odds grow quadratically while each clone still pays the full fourteen steps and one payout is shared; one honest agent walks the sonnet once.
